scope: Additive CIN-ATL correction after materially changed official sources. Cincinnati's official final page now binds the 34-17 final, line score, starting quarterbacks and offensive box-score participation. Atlanta's official recap binds an Olamide Zaccheaus possible-concussion evaluation and a return a few plays later. The prior complete candidate inactive/transaction sections remain bound by exact blob. The official PDF gamebook, full starter/substitute/DNP inventory, full specialist inventory, phase snaps and an exact printed Zaccheaus injury/return clock remain unavailable. No exposure fraction, replacement, injury loss, carried rating or issued Week 9 fair is changed.

sources.finding: The official Cincinnati page reports FINAL, a 34-17 Cincinnati win from quarter scores 7-17-7-3 and 10-0-7-0, Joe Burrow 24/29 for 271 yards with three passing touchdowns, and Michael Penix Jr. 20/31 for 162 yards with one touchdown and one interception. It supplies offensive box-score participation but not the complete official gamebook inventory.

The official Atlanta recap states that Olamide Zaccheaus was injured on his first punt return of the second half, underwent evaluation for a possible concussion, and returned to the field a few plays later. It does not print an exact play clock, diagnose a confirmed concussion, identify a distinct replacement, or provide phase snap exposure.

Carries forward the source-bound Sunday inactive/transaction inventory and explicit unresolved participation, DNP, injury, quarterback, specialist, exposure, replacement and value fields without rewriting the original receipt.
